title: 8 Sins a Godly Man Names Out Loud Before They Own Him
caption:
Confession isn't weakness. It's how a sin loses its grip.

Every sin on this list survives the same way: in silence. The porn nobody knows about. The bitterness he only says in the shower. The doubt he's never brought to another man. Named out loud, to God and to a brother, it starts to die. Kept in the dark, it just keeps growing.

"When I kept silent, my body wasted away... Then I acknowledged my sin to you, and the guilt was gone." (Psalm 32:3, 5)
